subject: [PATCH v4 14/21] f2fs: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations for the f2fs file system to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated using the DEFINE_IOMAP_ITER_NEXT() macro. This change does not introduce any functional changes and only updates the internal implementation of iomap operations. The goal is to align f2fs with the latest iomap API requirements.
